reviews.specification:
Develop hand-weave-fiber-mat(target, materials, mode, position), applicable to any learner and suitable accessible fibrous plant material, with modes test, assemble/resume, inspect, trial, repair, place, dismantle and cancel. Smallest product: one unbacked, hand-plaited portable sitting mat, nominally 0.45 x 0.45 m; no loom, cutting tool, cordage, adhesive or tree damage is assumed. Dependencies and exact references: reuse gather/base:gather:1 (handler forest.gather, foundation-forest@1) for collection, probe/open-baseline:probe:1 for observation/material trials, and existing pickup/drop/navigation rules for movement and transfer. Record any actual shared code reuse in the implementation manifest, including validation, item provenance and work-state code; do not describe this as reinventing those functions. branch-screen/shelter:woven-branch-windbreak:1 is a related non-equivalent reference, not a license to inherit its wind protection. The only identified candidate source is forest-dry-grass-0 at (14.2,16.3); it is not owned material. Collecting each unit costs one gather round and 2 energy, subtracting finite source stock in interaction range. Do not expose additional source facts or pre-commit its observed stock. Existing owned roots are not suitable inputs.
Prerequisites: completed individual study; reachable owned uncommitted material; free hands; a clear accessible working patch; enough energy for the next paid step. Test uses one actual 0.1-unit sample, one round and 0.5 energy through probe. Observe length, brittleness, moisture, bendability and whether hand-twisting and crossing strands produces a retaining edge. The sample becomes identified tested scraps, not an unexplained disappearance. Test passes only where actual stems can overlap into continuous strips, bend through the needed crossings without breaking, and retain their own tucked ends under gentle handling. No inferred suitability from the source name. Store measured results with sample provenance, method and material applicability; reassess degraded or materially different batches. The handoff must implement observable material-test outcomes, not ask the model to approve each attempt. If retained plaiting is infeasible, the test is the executable precursor; report why and leave manufacture unavailable for that material without permanently rejecting the general operation.
Assembly recipe: reserve exactly 4 whole suitable gathered units, separate from the test sample. These are a recipe allocation, not a guarantee of sufficient fiber. A dry layout must demonstrate enough usable stems to cover the nominal footprint in two crossing layers with overlapping ends and tucked edges. No unspecified unit-to-length or mass conversion may be invented: use actual resource geometry/properties established in implementation; if unavailable, implement the sample test first and report unresolved yield. Layout takes one round and 0.5 energy. Insufficient quantity or length produces a measured shortfall and no mat; release surviving reserved material once. A feasible layout proceeds through six paid rounds at 1 energy each: two strip-forming, three interlacing/edge-tucking, one lift-and-integrity check. Each paid round records its physical changes and costs once. Output passes only if it retains the footprint when lifted and laid down and has no major opening wider than 0.03 m. Otherwise it remains a loose or failed workpiece, not a completed mat.
Maintain a work record containing owner, exact input stack IDs and quantities, source provenance, material age/condition, sample result, location, reserved versus incorporated quantities, stage, paid progress and output identity. Each transfer subtracts that quantity from the source inventory; final material accounting is input = fiber retained in mat + recoverable offcuts + damaged scraps. Weaving cannot create biomass, reset decay or copy inventory. Preserve actual mass, moisture and provenance through processing. No food or nutrition is produced. Output remains an owned, portable physical item with measured dimensions, condition and actual fiber content, subject to existing carrying limits.
Insufficient energy, leaving reach, unavailable material or occupied workspace pauses before charging the next step; already performed steps persist. Resume revalidates conditions and starts at the recorded unpaid step. Manual interruption has the same behavior. Cancel costs no energy and releases unincorporated reserved inputs once; a partial workpiece and scraps stay real and recoverable at the site. Death stops work, releases reservations at the death/work location consistently with actual custody, and leaves physical workpieces rather than duplicating them. No time or energy refund; no restoration of damaged fibers. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing or charges.
Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy and records visible dimensions, moisture, gaps and condition without repairing anything. Place or lift costs one round and 0.2 energy, requires reach and a clear footprint outside obstructed movement space, and transfers the same item rather than creating a fixture. Dismantle costs one round and 0.5 energy, producing the actual recoverable fibers and scraps, with no restoration of consumed effort or broken stems. Repair requires an identified damaged area and one suitable owned unit per repair session: two rounds at 1 energy each to remove damaged fibers and interlace replacements, followed by the ordinary one-round, 1-energy integrity check. Replacement inputs must physically suffice; record unused surplus and removed scraps, and never increase condition or area beyond what the actual repaired weave supports.
Physical trial requires a completed mat, clear dry firm ground, and an actor independently choosing to sit on it for one round at 0.2 energy. Record flattening, slipping, breakage and skin-contact suitability. A passing trial requires retained weave under that actor's actual load, no slipping, and no sharp or irritating contacts. Only that demonstrated applicable load range permits a modest +0.5 physical-comfort contribution while actually sitting on the dry intact mat on such ground; total physical comfort is capped at 10 and equivalent cushioning contributions deduplicate rather than stack. Wet, displaced, damaged or untested conditions give no such contribution. Initial version has zero thermal-insulation, rain, wind, medical or nutrition effect; these cannot be inferred from appearance. No automatic sitting, belonging, attendance or social response. Any neighbor must communicate, approach and act independently.
Ongoing processes run in code only while world time advances: retain material moisture/decay behavior, plus mat-condition loss of 0.0005 per exposed round and 0.002 per occupied sitting round, clamped to [0,1]. At condition below 0.5 disable the comfort effect and mark integrity as needing repair/retrial. Wetting immediately suspends the dry-use effect; drying must arise from actual environmental exposure, not a free maintenance command. Damaged or degraded material is not renewed by inspection or relocation. No passive production, automatic repair or hidden maintenance supplies.
